penalty_basis: 0.35 x (map land mean of the old rain-gated field / mean of this field), raw climate, so the mean health burden and population totals stay as calibrated
activation: Off until the next full cascade rebuild: every atlas add-on (settlements, reach, administration, coverage, pasture, presence) is bound to the harvest fingerprint, so switching the export changes them all. Until then the validated field is shown as its own layer (land_malaria_v2).
